struct ara::diag::SovdAuthorization::ValidateAuthorizationOutput
Symbol:
identity
Type:
ara::core::Optional< ara::core::String >
Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<ara::core::String> identity;
▽ △
Description:
Identity of the client. This identity string if present will be used to re-identify a client even if it
uses a new token (e.g. because the old one expired) so that it has access to the temporary
resources (e.g. running routines, locks, etc.). If the identity string is the same as one returned
earlier, the client will be considered identical. Depending on the security concept it could be for
example the ’client_id’, the ’sub’, or a combination of both. If the identity string is not provided,
the client will only have access to the temporary resources as long as it provides the same
access token and validUntil is not yet expired.
⌋
